body:
Demo stage: 1

Jutin's token workspace (#64, PR #105) offers 15m, 4h and 1D chart intervals, but the API contract's `CandleInterval` (`proto/omnimarket/api/v1/market.proto`) only has 1s, 1m, 5m and 1h. Temi decided the contract gains the three intervals rather than the chart dropping them.

## Acceptance criteria
- `CandleInterval` gains 15m, 4h and 1D values, added without renumbering existing values (`buf breaking` passes).
- The generated TypeScript in `web/terminal/src/api/generated` is regenerated and the staleness check passes.
- MSW fixtures cover at least one candle series at each new interval.
- If the candle builder (`crates/candles/`) exists on main when this is built, it can produce the new intervals; if not, `docs/spec/data.md` notes that the builder must support them.
- `docs/spec/data.md` and `docs/spec/frontend.md` list the new intervals.

Related: #64, PR #105 (consumer).
